summary: Accepted the beneficiary relationship from digital attention, gaming, and consumer ecosystems to Roblox with high positive sensitivity and medium confidence. Current SEC-hosted issuer evidence establishes a direct causal path from creator content and discovery through users, hours, payers, bookings, revenue, and cash flow, while safety interventions, creator and infrastructure costs, losses, deferred-revenue timing, and dilution limit per-share conversion. Updated the relationship page, catalog, log, and canonical relationship row; no strategy or follow-up operation was created because the current bounded base and downside scenarios remain below market.

evidence.claim: Roblox's SEC-hosted Q1 2026 shareholder letter reports 35% daily-user growth to 132 million, 43% hours growth to 31 billion, 52% monthly-unique-payer growth to 31 million, 43% bookings growth to USD 1.7 billion, and USD 596 million of free cash flow. Content outside the top ten experiences supplied 65% of Robux-spend growth, establishing direct operating exposure to creator supply, discovery, engagement, and monetization rather than ticker-level correlation.

The same issuer evidence records a safety-led reduction in full-year bookings-growth guidance to 8-12%, rising developer-exchange and trust-and-safety costs, a widened net loss, and 749 million fully diluted shares. These counterweights make thematic sensitivity high but keep confidence in durable per-share value conversion at medium.

The current Roblox assessment uses a validated USD 48.42 mark and bounded 12-month downside and base scenarios 47.9% and 19.9% below market, respectively, so accepting the causal edge does not justify strategy research or a signal.
